svg.text: REFLECTOR SUPPORT SLATS — flush support faces — revision 02
Five slats per side per bay. Support faces flush with rib surface; bent tabs bolt to the rib faces.
Gold faces flush with rib surface.
Bottom moved clear; top edge ends at rib tip.
ONE BAY — one reflector side shown
Flush support faces, tangent to the curve.
Slat thickness stays below the support face.
ONE SLAT — side view along its length
Slat thickness sits below the rib support level; end tabs bend away from the reflector.
Slat top flush with rib top
Bent tabs against rib faces, bolted through.
Concept 02 • 5 per side per bay = 40 slats over four bays. Schematic; strip size, bend radius and fastener locations are not yet selected.
